summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a pricing supplement (Form 424B5) for a $5.769 million aggregate principal amount of Senior Fixed Rate 10-Year Callable Notes due June 30, 2036, issued at $1,000 per note (100% of par) with a 6.00% semi-annual interest coupon. The issuer has the right to redeem notes in whole or in part on each Optional Redemption Date (starting June 30, 2028). There is no special situation; it is an ordinary debt takedown under an existing shelf registration. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No deal terms apply.
